meta.purpose: Connections — white-matter pathways, region-to-region relations, and network groupings.
meta.primary_source: NIH 3D 3DPX-003145 Fractional Anisotropy (diffusion MRI) white-matter model, Nevit Dilmen
meta.disclaimer: Named tracts are educational graph edges informed by textbook pathways. The FA mesh is an intensity surface of anisotropy, not a labelled tractography atlas. Alignment of axons (e.g. corpus callosum) raises FA; that is a physical measurement, not a function assignment.

fa_mesh.description: Intensity of fractional anisotropy of human brain from diffusion MRI converted to 3D model.
fa_mesh.note: Interior to the cortical mesh (compare 3DPX-003765 X ±83 mm vs FA X ±47 mm). White matter is STRUCTURE/TRACT space, not FUNCTION space.

meta.educational_source: Rita Carter et al., The Brain Book (DK, 2019) — language fibre tracts (arcuate fasciculus); DTI fibre colour conventions (interhemispheric, limbic, cerebellar)

tracts.notes: Commissural fibres. High FA where axons align (educational FA definition from the NIH 3D entry).
The Brain Book: in humans this tract links frontal generation areas with temporal comprehension areas. It is a TRACT, not language itself.
Descending motor pathway. Movement is still a PROCESS distributed across cortex, basal ganglia, cerebellum, and this tract.
Limbic association fibres. Green-coded limbic fibres are mentioned in The Brain Book DTI plate.
Orbitofrontal–temporal connection. A CONNECTION candidate, not a personality trait.
Frontoparietal association fibres used in attention and spatial models.
Visual pathway segment. Seeing remains a FUNCTION of a pathway-plus-network, not a REGION.
The Brain Book DTI plate: fibres running from the cerebellum toward the spine.

networks.notes: Action selection / evaluation loop. Not equal to frontal_lobe.
The Brain Book: desire and reward involve distributed valuation circuits.
The Brain Book: main language areas are usually left-lateralized, but complete hearing and prosody recruit the right hemisphere. Not a single coordinate.
The Brain Book discusses an idling / internally oriented brain. This is a NETWORK label, not a self.
